reason: I'd probably start the 14-day trial since it's free and won't auto-charge, but on day 14 I'd go back to YouTube or the free version. With almost no income, 4,900 won a month for sleep sounds is hard to justify when I already have free ones.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and the free version already has a 30/60-minute off timer. The 'resume where it cut off' button still means grabbing my phone at night, and the automatic version needs an armband that doesn't come out until 2028 and costs extra.
would_change_my_mind: If my day-14 record showed I was clearly falling asleep a lot faster, like 15+ minutes, I might pay for one month just to see if it holds.
